steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation screen.
Ensure vendor addition and publishing are available during event creation.
Set the event type to RFQ and configure whole-lot awarding.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is created.
Add the specified product; its available variant should populate in the sheet.
Complete the remaining pricing-sheet fields before testing the quantity value.
Verify the product's mapped variant is populated as expected.
Enter the very large requested quantity into the sheet.
Confirm the quantity is retained, formatted with thousands separators, and not marked as an error.
Check that calculated totals and the sheet show no overflow, NaN, undefined, or other rendering errors.
Add one available QA test vendor so the event can be published.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Confirm publication completed without an application error.
